correctness.rationale: In F16=F2[t]/(t^4+t+1), alpha=t has order 15; fifteen binary check columns (alpha^i,alpha^-i) define the 8-dimensional syndrome image of this code. Every binary 3-space has a unique echelon basis; the Gaussian coefficient [8 choose 3]_2=97155. For each space its support cost is the smallest cardinality of a subset of check columns with a containing F2 span; containment of all eight syndrome vectors is equivalent to W being contained. An independent C++ exhaustive enumerator constructs all coordinate spans of sizes 3..7 and all 97155 distinct RREF three-spaces. It reproduces the exact histogram (330,6510,39885,49230,1200) at costs 3..7 and checks no missing cases. The result is finite-only and does not establish an infinite family.

value.rationale: This is the complete distribution of a natural generalized-covering invariant of the fixed binary length-15 Melas code, a useful code-theoretic object. Knowing only generalized covering radius 7 gives neither number of radius-maximizing three-syndrome subspaces (1200) nor intermediate support costs; a practitioner studying simultaneous error patterns may need each coefficient. It is a motivated complete finite classification, not a replacement for the published maximum radius.
